title: [0.100] Command Palette: incorrect dock position on 2nd display

status.label: Reproduction evidence available
status.detail: The report has deterministic monitor-topology steps and a diagnostic archive; maintainer reproduction is the next useful action.

next_action.label: Reproduce secondary-monitor dock placement
next_action.reason: Compare the independent no-Windhawk report with the original Taskbar-on-Top interaction.

judgment.rationale: The detailed second report makes the secondary-monitor failure reproducible without Windhawk and rules out mixed resolution, mixed DPI, dock-on-both-monitors, and primary-monitor choice as necessary conditions. The first reporter separately identified a Windhawk Taskbar-on-Top interaction, so maintainers should keep both scenarios distinct instead of attributing all failures to that mod.
evidence: The reporter supplied Windows 11 25H2, PowerToys 0.100.2, two 1920x1080 monitors at 100% scaling, and a fresh bug report captured immediately after reproduction.
The dock remains broken on monitor 2 when it is the only enabled dock, after changing the primary display, and after rearranging the monitor positions.
The original reporter reports a separate Windhawk Taskbar-on-Top interaction; the second reproduction occurs without Windhawk, so Windhawk cannot explain the entire report.
The issue remains open and has no assignee; the live labels include Needs-Team-Response.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the dock placement failure on current supported PowerToys and compare the reported 0.100.2 topology with and without Windhawk Taskbar-on-Top.

fix_assessment.rationale: The symptom is corroborated, but the placement calculation and Windhawk interaction have not been independently reproduced on current source.

initial_investigation: Read the issue body and all seven public comments, including the detailed 0.100.2 report and linked bug-report attachment.

Confirmed the reporter tried monitor-only docking, changing the primary monitor, rearranging displays, and equal resolution/scaling; no diagnostic archive contents or current-build reproduction were inspected.

reproduce.title: Validate Command Palette Dock placement on monitor 2
reproduce.version_requirement: Compare the reported PowerToys 0.100.2 behavior with the current supported build.
prerequisites: Windows 11 with two 1920x1080 monitors at 100% scaling.
steps: Enable the Dock only on monitor 2 and record its size and position.
Make monitor 2 the Windows primary display, then restore monitor 1 as primary; rearrange monitor positions and repeat.
Repeat without Windhawk, then with the Taskbar-on-Top mod enabled before enabling the Dock.
Capture a fresh /bugreport immediately after any failure.
reproduce.expected_result: The Dock has the configured size and position on monitor 2; any failure is attributed to the no-Windhawk or Taskbar-on-Top scenario separately.

actions.label: Review Dock placement fix direction after reproduction
actions.note: Approve a code-level design only after maintainer reproduction identifies the failing geometry or external-mod interaction.

proposed_fixes.title: Correct Command Palette Dock placement on secondary monitors
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A hypothesis is that Dock placement uses monitor/taskbar work-area geometry inconsistently on the secondary display; the evidence does not yet identify a specific calculation or prove the Windhawk path is the same defect.
plan: Reproduce the no-Windhawk report with the dock enabled only on monitor 2, then repeat with monitor 2 primary and with the original Taskbar-on-Top mod.
Trace the monitor bounds, work area, DPI and docking coordinates used when the dock is created; compare the values across the two reported configurations.
If the same placement defect is confirmed, correct the specific geometry source and add regression coverage for secondary-monitor-only docking.
verification: On current supported PowerToys, the dock is correctly sized and positioned on monitor 2 in the no-Windhawk scenario.
The original Taskbar-on-Top scenario is either separately reproduced and fixed or shown to be an external interaction; do not treat it as the sole root cause.
Changing primary monitor or rearranging the displays does not regress normal docking.

confidence.rationale: The symptom and topology are detailed, but current-build source behavior and the failing geometry calculation are unverified.
